name: control_sequence
about: The host's own control: a path-free Troika program whose finite activity must finish with nothing rendering. A neutral npc_VHumanCombatant with no patrol, no interesting places and no alert lookaround, standing with the player in view, is selected SCHED_TROIKA_IDLE_DISPOSITION by the idle arm of CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule (0x102af8dc; cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_idle_disposition.sch: TASK_SPECIAL_IDLE_ACTIVITY 5, TASK_WAIT_PVS 0). Its RunTask arm (0x102ab369) runs the stance machine (slot 588) and, once the activity finishes, restarts ACT_INTEREST_IDLE; ResetSequenceInfo (0x10090950) plays the clip at rate 1 and StudioFrameAdvance (0x1008f120) raises m_bSequenceFinished at its end. No path task runs, so no body claim stands between the kernel's commit and the body. Red here means the headless host does not animate, and every animation expectation elsewhere is red for the wrong reason. (The flinch candidate was read and refused: a damaged idle Troika goes ALERT and SCHED_TROIKA_SHOT_BY_UNKNOWN, 0x102b8c40, which paths; SMALL_FLINCH is the COMBAT arm, 0x102afcae.)
